text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has reaffirmed Vietnam's determination to help Cuba through its difficulties.
- The government has submitted a feasibility study on the restoration of a rail route from Ho Chi Minh City to Di An and Loc Ninh on the Cambodian border.
- The Trade Ministry has prepared a list of key export goods for development between now and 2000.
- The supply of electric power to northern Vietnam has begun to normalise following the arrival of rains in the area to feed hydroelectric plants, but supply has not yet reached demand.
- Deputy Prime Minister Phan Van Khai has assured Burma that Vietnam will do its utmost to support Rangoon in joining the ASEAN regional grouping.
- Circulation figures for the Nhan Dan newspaper have increased in the northern province of Quang Ninh.
- A whirlwind storm has destroyed 149 houses in the central province of Quang Ninh.
- Hanoi will take stronger steps to ensure that private businesses register with the city authorities.
